name: Sunset Bay RV Resort & Campground
note: Family-run Lake Superior campground since 1944 on the Keweenaw shore at Ahmeek (2701 Sunset Bay Beach Rd); ~28 RV sites with water + 30-amp electric (a few with sewer, 50-amp pull-throughs), tent sites and cabins among the trees behind 2,500 ft of pebble-and-sand beach - every site a short walk to the beach, none on it. Reservable online. July 2027 weeknight: W/E sites $40-45 (smaller back-ins to 25-35 ft $40), W/E/sewer $50, 50-amp pull-through FHU $55; rates cover 4 adults. RV Life 4*/$$$ ~$43/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: sunset-bay.com + ResNexus live quote Wed 2027-07-14 (4 adults): RV29 W/E 30A to 35 ft $40, RV13/14/17-20 W/E $45, sewer sites $50, 50A pull-thrus $55 -> real transient RV campground; published base $40 (2027 quote) <= $50; RV Life 4* over 57 reviews
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 47.3794,-88.3982: RV clearings sit in mixed woods 100-150 m back from the Lake Superior beach with a continuous treeline between; operator says every site is 'an easy walk to the beach' and no site class is sold as beachfront

name: Sunrise Lake Family Campground
note: Family campground on the west shore of private Sunrise Lake at 15230 S Spencer Rd near LeRoy, beside the DNR ATV trails; water + 30-amp electric sites (premium lake-view sites for big rigs, standard sites a short walk from the beach), rustic tent sites, cabins and rental campers. 2026 rates: standard W/E from $50/night, premium from $60, rustic $35; monthly $800 + electric. Distinct from Sunrise Lake State Forest Campground (id 14036) 650 m south. Unrated on RV Life; Google 4.9 over 77 reviews. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: sunriselakefamilycampground.com/rates (read 2026-09-30): nightly Standard Sites W/E 30A 'from $50/night', Premium from $60, Rustic from $35 -> real transient RV campground; published base $50 (2026) <= $50; quality: not rated on RV Life, Google Maps 4.9 over 77 reviews

name: Oak Knoll Family Campground
note: Wooded family campground on Fruitvale Rd E near Holton, north of Big Blue Lake at the edge of the Manistee National Forest; rustic, electric, water/electric and full-hookup sites plus cabins and rental trailers; 2-night minimum on rentals. Operator nightly rates: rustic $35, electric $47, W/E $55, FHU $65. Pin is on the site loop under canopy, matched to the street address. Not on RV Life; Good Sam 8/7/7.7 (appeal/facility/general, unstarred); Google 4.8 over 133 reviews. --Claude

name: The Groves of Michigan
note: Large campground and event grounds on 200+ acres across US-12/Brooklyn Hwy from Michigan International Speedway (13500 US-12, Brooklyn); a main campground of ~350 electric (some water) sites in woods and open ground, plus ~1,300 rustic sites in two fields used on NASCAR and festival weekends. Takes regular nightly reservations as well as seasonals, open early May - late October. Non-event nights $50 incl. fees and taxes for 30-amp + water (+$5 for 50-amp), 2-night minimum; race and festival weekends priced separately and very busy. Pin is on the main campground (OSM still names it Juniper Hills). Not on RV Life; Google 4.5 over 31 reviews. --Claude

name: Jack's Landing Resort
note: Resort on Fletcher Pond (Fletcher Floodwaters) at 20836 Tennis Rd, Hillman, running since 1938: lodge rooms, lakefront cabins and a campground of electric and water/electric sites in angled rows above the marina, plus rustic wooded sites; boat rentals, docks and shore fishing. 2026 price list: electric (15/30-amp) $37/night, water + electric $42, rustic $30, for 4 people. Not on RV Life; Google 4.5 over 361 reviews. --Claude

name: Muskegon River Campground
note: Small campground opened in 2022 at 6190 W 112th St, Grant, between the road and the Muskegon River; 24 water + electric sites, bathhouse with showers, dump station, large pavilion. No seasonal sites; 21-night maximum stay; reservations required, booked online. $35/night (2026). The river is ~300 m south and the nearest put-in is a township launch under a mile away. RV Life 5*/$$ ~$35/night (auto 9/2026); Google 4.8 over 65 reviews. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: muskegonrivercampground.com: 24 premium W/E sites, rates page $35/night, 'no seasonal sites, 21-day maximum stay', online booking -> real transient RV campground; published base $35 (2026) <= $50; quality: RV Life 5* rests on 1 review, Google Maps 4.8 over 65 reviews

name: Daisy Park Campground
note: Public campground at SON-Life Camp & Retreat Center, a Christian camp at 189 126th Ave near Wayland; about 20 water + electric sites on a wooded strip along the camp's lake, with swimming at the camp waterfront until dusk. Individual reservations open December 1. $40/site Sun-Thu (one household or up to four people), $45 on holiday weekends; +$5 per extra person. Camp programs run alongside. Not on RV Life; Good Sam 7.5/5.5/7.2; Google 4.5 over 38 reviews. --Claude
